entries.reason: 核對遮蔽再生數值的過載條件，保留固定 5 秒。

entries.source: Your Air Magic spells that target a foe activate and recharge 33% faster, but you are Overcast by 2 points

entries.reason: 核對過載才施加降咒，保留固定中文技能身份與時間。

entries.source: For 1…7…8 seconds, you block the next attack against you and deal 10…42…50 damage to your attacker

entries.reason: 核對僅下一次攻擊、傷害對象為攻擊者。

entries.source: For 20 seconds, you have a 40% chance to block and an extra 4…9…10% for each additional enchantment (max 80%)

entries.reason: 核對基礎格擋、逐加持的增幅及最高上限。

entries.source: For 20 seconds, you have a 40% chance to block and an extra ◆ for each additional enchantment (max 80%)

entries.source:
When this skill's functionality changed, the Polish description was updated incorrectly. It mentions too little additional damage while Overcast:
Spell. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage to two nearby foes if you are Overcast. 25% armor penetration.
entries.text:
此技能機制變更時，波蘭文說明更新有誤，將過載時的額外傷害寫得過低：
咒文魔法。造成 5…33…40 點閃電傷害。若你處於過載狀態，對附近兩名敵人造成 5…33…40 點閃電傷害。具有 25% 護甲穿透。
entries.reason: 核對這是波蘭文舊說明的錯誤範例；保留被指出有誤的引文數值，不誤當目前正確傷害。

entries.text:
錯誤：此技能機制變更時，波蘭文說明更新有誤，將過載時的額外傷害寫得過低：
咒文魔法。造成 5…33…40 點閃電傷害。若你處於過載狀態，對附近兩名敵人造成 5…33…40 點閃電傷害。具有 25% 護甲穿透。
entries.reason: 核對錯誤標記及波蘭文引文；保留錯誤示例的三段數值而不擅自修成目前傷害。

entries.source:
* Targets hexed by Arcane Languor will suffer a total 20 additional overcast after successfully casting a spell that normally has overcast in the presence of Equinox.
* Overcast occurs after the spell completes casting.
entries.text:
* 受到魔法耗盡降咒的目標，在晝夜的範圍內成功施放原本會造成過載的魔法後，總共額外累積 20 點過載。
* 過載在魔法施放完成後產生。
entries.reason: 核對魔法耗盡與晝夜疊加的額外過載；後一句描述此降咒的觸發時點。

entries.source:
* You can get a quick adrenaline boost at the start of a battle by using this skill 10-15 seconds before engaging the enemy.

Similar to other skills with an end effect, the end effect of Balthazar's Rage will trigger upon death. When a character who died while enchanted with Balthazar's Rage is resurrected, the adrenaline gained from this skill's end effect will still be active on the character, instead of having no adrenaline when resurrected.
entries.text:
* 在接敵前 10-15 秒使用此技能，可在戰鬥開始時迅速獲得怒氣。

與其他具有結束效果的技能相同，巴薩澤盛怒的結束效果會在死亡時觸發。角色在此加持生效期間死亡，復活後仍保有結束效果所獲得的怒氣，而非以零怒氣復活。
entries.reason: 核對交戰前的時間與死亡時觸發；角色是在加持期間死亡，不是因加持而死。

entries.source:
* Heroes will maintain this skill in combat even when fighting enemies that don't apply any conditions. This is useful for triggering skills that trigger when an enchantment ends, such as forms. 
* When used in conjunction with an attack skill that removes an enchantment, conditions are cured before the hit lands.
* If the condition removal effect is unwanted (to keep Conviction's regeneration and armor increase effects), it can be worth considering using an enchanting upgrade component (or an effect reducing recharge time) to maintain this skill on yourself, as conditions are not removed if the enchantment is reapplied before it ends.
entries.text:
* 英雄在戰鬥中會維持此技能，即使敵人不施加任何病症也一樣。這有助於觸發加持結束時生效的技能，例如形態。
* 搭配會移除加持的攻擊技能時，病症會在攻擊命中前解除。
* 若想避免移除病症，以保留信念的體力再生與護甲加成，可考慮使用延長加持時間的武器升級組件，或縮短冷卻時間的效果，來持續維持此技能。在加持結束前重新施加加持，就不會移除病症。
entries.reason: 核對病症、命中前解除及重新施加加持的對象；不是重新施加病症。

entries.source:
* A skill that changes your weapon damage type to earth damage, like Staggering Force or Dust Cloak, will count as wielding an earth weapon.
* The added earth damage is armor-ignoring.
* Queue this skill while knocked down to avoid being quarterknocked by physical attacks.
entries.text:
* 將武器傷害屬性改為土系的技能，例如驚天神力或塵土掩蔽，會被視為持用土系武器。
* 額外的土系傷害無視護甲。
* 被擊倒時將此技能排入施放佇列，可避免起身後立刻又被物理攻擊擊倒（quarterknock）。
entries.reason: 核對傷害屬性轉換可滿足武器條件、附傷無視護甲；quarterknock 保留起身再遭擊倒的時序。

entries.source:
* This skill increases average speed by 11.67% if used every time it recharges. 
* This can be maintained indefinitely with Extend Enchantments at Mysticism 11 (or 9 when using a 20% of Enchanting weapon).
entries.text:
* 每次冷卻完成就使用此技能，平均移動速度可提高 11.67%。
* 搭配加持延展，祕法達 11 時可無限維持此技能；若使用延長加持時間 20% 的武器，祕法只需達 9。
entries.reason: 核對冷卻後重施的平均速度，以及祕法 11 或武器加成下 9 的二擇門檻。

entries.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Equinox.
* The additional overcast caused by Equinox triggers only after the spell is cast successfully, whereas ordinary overcast occurs when activation begins.
* The additional overcast stacks with Arcane Languor, resulting in a total 20 additional overcast when using a spell that causes overcast.
entries.text:
* 此技能會創造 Spirit of Equinox。
* 晝夜造成的額外過載僅在魔法成功施放後觸發；一般過載則在開始施放時產生。
* 額外過載可與魔法耗盡疊加。施放會造成過載的魔法時，總共額外累積 20 點過載。
entries.reason: 核對精靈身份、成功施放與開始施放的不同時點；未證實中文精靈名保留英文。

entries.source:
*Exhausting Assault is the only dual attack skill that doesn't require an off-hand attack skill to precede it.
*This skill will inflict overcast on its target even if the interruption is prevented.
*As this is an attack skill, the activation time is actually 0.25 second.
*If the target is skill queuing, this attack can interrupt two skills. This way, it is possible to inflict 20 overcast with one attack.
*A target elementalist may actually benefit from the effects of this skill, as some of their skills gain additional effects while the caster is overcast.
entries.text:
* 衰竭突襲是唯一不要求先使用副手攻擊技能的雙重攻擊技能。
* 即使中斷被阻止，此技能仍會使目標累積過載。
* 由於此技能是攻擊技能，實際施放時間為 0.25 秒。
* 若目標已將技能排入佇列，此攻擊能中斷兩個技能。因此一次攻擊可造成 20 點過載。
* 目標元素使反而可能受益，因為部分元素使技能在施放者處於過載狀態時會有額外效果。
entries.reason: 核對雙重攻擊前置例外、中斷防護仍累積過載、技能佇列的雙中斷與元素使受益條件。

entries.source:
* Glyph of Energy only cancels the base overcast cost of the spells, not overcast caused by other sources. 
** Arcane Languor and Iron Mist will still cause overcast on spells. 
** Over the Limit will still generate passive overcast. 
** Equinox and Sheer Exhaustion will not cause overcast. 
* Skills that let Glyph of Energy use its full potential are Maelstrom, Meteor Shower, Earthquake, and its duplicate Dragon's Stomp.
* A cancelled spell will still consume one use of the glyph. 
* Non-spell elemental skills (Lightning Touch, Shock, Glyph of Immolation and Glyph of Swiftness) will take advantage of the bonus and will not count as a use of the glyph. 
* Any elemental attribute raised to at least 9 will trigger the bonus armor from Prismatic Insignia.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
entries.text:
* 能量符號只取消魔法本身的基本過載消耗，不取消其他來源造成的過載。
** 魔法耗盡與鐵之迷霧仍會使施放的魔法造成過載。
** Over the Limit 仍會被動累積過載。
** 晝夜與 Sheer Exhaustion 不會造成過載。
* 水漩渦、隕石雨、地震及其同效技能 地龍踩踏 能充分發揮能量符號的效益。
* 取消施放的魔法仍會消耗符號的一次使用機會。
* 不屬於魔法的元素技能（閃電之觸、電擊、Glyph of Immolation 與 Glyph of Swiftness）可獲得加成，且不消耗符號的使用次數。
* 任何元素屬性提高至至少 9，都會觸發 Prismatic Insignia 的額外護甲。
* 沒有持續時間限制，是少數無須維持消耗即可無限持續的技能之一。
entries.reason: 逐項核對來源備註列出的過載例外、取消施放仍消耗次數、非魔法技能不消耗次數與屬性門檻；無固定中文身份的名稱保留英文。

entries.source:
* The initial holy damage dealt by this skill is armor-ignoring damage; the holy damage dealt by attacks is armor-respecting.
* Heroes will maintain this enchantment out of combat. They will also attempt to move into range of enemies to deal damage with it, which may be undesirable for ranged attacking heroes.
entries.text:
* 此技能的初始神聖傷害無視護甲；攻擊造成的神聖傷害則依護甲計算。
* 英雄會在非戰鬥狀態維持此加持，也會嘗試靠近敵人，以此技能造成傷害。這種走位對遠程攻擊英雄可能不利。
entries.reason: 核對兩種神聖傷害對護甲的不同計算方式，以及英雄主動靠近敵人的行為。

entries.source:
The effects of this skill apply to all spells, regardless of target or attribute.
* It takes 6s to recover from 2 points of overcast. If you cast more than three spells while under the effect of this enchantment, you will not be able to completely recover from this skill's overcast during its recharge.
** If you are concerned about building up too much overcast, consider a lower attribute investment and shorter enchantment duration. Only use the spells that really need the reduced casting time and recharge time while enchanted by Iron Mist. Cast your other spells when this enchantment has worn off. Non-spell skills can be activated any time. Alternatively, use Soul Ignition to recover from Overcast.
* The overcast caused by this skill is not increased by Equinox, and not prevented by Glyph of Energy.
* The overcast caused by casting a spell is applied in time to trigger that spell’s additional effects.
entries.text:
此技能的效果適用於所有魔法，不限目標或屬性。
* 消退 2 點過載需要 6 秒。若此加持生效期間施放超過三個魔法，就無法在此技能冷卻完成前完全消退它造成的過載。
** 若擔心過載累積過多，可降低屬性投入，縮短加持時間。在鐵之迷霧生效時，只施放確實需要縮短施放與冷卻時間的魔法；其他魔法留待加持結束後使用。不屬於魔法的技能可隨時使用。也可用 Soul Ignition 消退過載。
* 此技能造成的過載不會被晝夜增加，也不會被能量符號阻止。
* 施放魔法造成的過載會及時生效，足以觸發該魔法的額外效果。
entries.reason: 核對來源所記載的實際效果例外、6 秒單位、超過三個魔法的門檻與過載生效時序；不把非魔法技能誤譯為非法技能。

entries.source:
With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), the only Dervish enchantments this skill's damage can trigger for are Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and Mirage Cloak itself. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Mirage Cloak (plus Mirage Cloak itself).
*This skill triggers itself when it ends.
*Pious Renewal synergizes with this skill because of its "recharge on end" effect.
The concise description omits that block chance is capped to 80%.
entries.text:

* 此技能結束時，也會觸發自己的傷害效果。
* 神性修補在結束時立即完成冷卻，因此與此技能搭配良好。
簡短說明省略了格擋機率最高為 80% 的限制。

entries.source:
* Due to the extremely high passive overcast, Soul Ignition is strongly recommended.
* The recharge reduction stacks with Fast Casting for Mesmer spells.
*This skill has both regular upkeep cost and overcast "upkeep". The overcast rate is three points of overcast per second.
**Assuming this is the only overcast skill used, and that it is recast every time it recharges, the enchantment must be dismissed around 2 seconds after casting it to avoid building overcast.
*Overcast caused by this spell will not be negated with Glyph of Energy.
entries.text:
* 由於此技能被動累積過載的速度極高，強烈建議搭配 Soul Ignition。
* 施放幻術師魔法時，冷卻縮減可與快速施法疊加。
* 此技能同時具有一般維持消耗與過載「維持」消耗；每秒累積三點過載。
** 假設沒有使用其他造成過載的技能，且每次冷卻完成就重新施放，必須在施放後約 2 秒解除加持，才能避免過載持續累積。
* 此魔法造成的過載不會被能量符號抵消。
entries.reason: 核對雙重維持代價、每秒三點、約兩秒後解除及計算假設；專名無固定中文證據保留英文。

entries.source:
* The projectile's arc is much higher than similar spells like Fireball.
* This spell will not fail if the target dies during its casting.
* The healing does not affect allied spirits.
* Useful when playing alongside a Minion Master or close combat professions, as they will benefit from the healing reliably if they're targeting the same enemy.
entries.text:
* 投射物的拋物線比火球等類似魔法高得多。
* 即使目標在施放期間死亡，此魔法也不會失敗。
* 治療效果不影響友方精靈。
* 與操縱不死生物的角色或近戰職業搭配時很有用；若他們攻擊同一名敵人，就能穩定受益於治療效果。
entries.reason: 核對投射物軌跡、目標死亡仍可施放、精靈治療例外；Minion Master 是操縱不死生物的玩法。

entries.source:
* Very useful in Random Arenas, as almost everyone is likely to have a Resurrection Signet equipped.
* The description is ambiguous. Rust will only disable a single signet on a target, and only if that target is casting a signet when struck. Additionally, Rust will disable that signet even if the target is under an effect that prevents interruption.
* Rust will not fail if the target dies before the skill completes casting.
entries.text:
* 在隨機競技場很有用，因為幾乎每個人都可能裝備復活紋章。
* 說明不夠明確：紋章鏽蝕只會停用目標的一個紋章，而且目標必須在命中時正在使用該紋章。即使目標受到防止中斷的效果保護，紋章鏽蝕仍會停用該紋章。
* 即使目標在施放完成前死亡，紋章鏽蝕也不會失敗。
entries.reason: 核對只停用正在使用的一個紋章，防中斷不防停用，並保留目標死亡例外。

entries.source: * Like Lightning Hammer, Cracked Armor is applied after calculating damage.
entries.text: * 與閃電之鎚相同，先計算傷害，之後才施加護甲破損。
entries.reason: 核對傷害計算與施加病症的先後順序。

entries.source:
* The Burning duration is applied every second and matches the amount of Overcast removed.
** Under all attribute ranks, Burning is continuous for the purpose of skills like Fragility and Contagion (unless the condition is removed, in which case it will be reapplied the next second).
* Combine with Frigid Armor to prevent the burning on the user.
* Can be used to counteract the overcast building effects of Over the Limit or Iron Mist.
* Although not stated in the skill description, the enchantment automatically ends when the user has no overcast.
* Unlike the PvE-only elite skills, the descriptions fail to mention that this is a PvE skill.
* At low Energy Storage ranks, Purifying Veil prevents burning on the user entirely. Recovery is, as noted on the skill's own page, a reduction in duration and requires more than 50% reduction to reduce a 1 second duration burn to a value that is rounded to 0.
The animation of the Burning condition does not occur the first time the skill is used in an explorable area.
entries.text:
* 每秒施加一次燃燒，燃燒持續秒數與移除的過載點數相同。
** 在任何屬性等級下，對脆弱、病症蔓延等技能而言，燃燒都視為連續持續；若病症被移除，則在下一秒重新施加。
* 搭配冰凍護甲可防止使用者燃燒。
* 可用於抵消 Over the Limit 或鐵之迷霧累積過載的效果。
* 雖然技能說明沒有提及，使用者沒有過載時，此加持會自動結束。
* 與僅限 PvE 的精英技能不同，此技能的說明沒有標明它是 PvE 技能。
* 能量儲存等級較低時，Purifying Veil 可完全防止使用者燃燒。痊癒的效果如其技能頁所述，是縮短持續時間；必須縮短超過 50%，才能讓持續 1 秒的燃燒四捨五入為 0 秒。
第一次在可探索區域使用此技能時，不會出現燃燒病症的動畫。
entries.reason: 核對逐秒施加與燃燒連續判定、無過載自動結束、PvE 限定及嚴格超過 50% 的取整門檻。

entries.source:
* This spell is an effective knock down even with no points in Air Magic.
* The enemies do not have to be attacking the user to be knocked down.
* This skill combines well with Aftershock.
entries.text:
* 即使未投入任何風系魔法屬性點，此魔法仍能有效擊倒敵人。
* 敵人不必正在攻擊使用者，也會被擊倒。
* 此技能適合搭配餘震。
entries.reason: 核對零屬性點仍可擊倒、無須敵人正在攻擊的條件與搭配技能。

entries.source: *No energy gain if recast.
entries.text: * 在此加持結束前重新施放，不會獲得能量。
